Contributing to micropubr

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thanks for helping improve micropubr. Bug reports, documentation fixes and pull requests are all welcome.

Reporting a bug

Open an issue at https://github.com/daniilidisK/micropubr/issues using the bug report template. Please include a minimal reproducible example (ideally with reprex::reprex()), built on a small or public dataset such as data(GlobalPatterns, package = "phyloseq"), plus your sessionInfo().

Development setup

# Install dependencies, including Bioconductor ones (phyloseq, DESeq2, ...)
install.packages(c("devtools", "BiocManager"))
devtools::install_dev_deps(dependencies = TRUE)

devtools::load_all()      # load the package from source
devtools::document()      # regenerate man/ and NAMESPACE from roxygen
devtools::test()          # run the test suite
devtools::check()         # full R CMD check

Never edit NAMESPACE or man/*.Rd by hand; they are generated by roxygen2 (markdown enabled).

Tests

  • Tests use testthat (3rd edition) and live in tests/testthat/. Run them with devtools::test(), or a single file with devtools::test(filter = "alpha").
  • Shared fixtures (make_test_ps(), make_da_df()) are in tests/testthat/helper-fixtures.R; use them instead of downloading data.
  • Guard optional dependencies with skip_if_not_installed("pkg").
  • Visual regression tests use vdiffr: vdiffr::expect_doppelganger("name", p). Snapshots are stored in tests/testthat/_snaps/. After an intentional visual change, review and accept them with testthat::snapshot_review() and commit the updated SVGs. CI uploads changed snapshots as an artifact when a check fails.
  • Test error conditions by class, not message: expect_error(mp_alpha(ps, group.by = "Nonexistent"), class = "micropubr_bad_var").

Code conventions

  • One verb family. User-facing functions are mp_*() verbs (mp_alpha(), mp_ordination(), …). Internal helpers start with .mp_ and are documented with @noRd.

  • Shared argument names. Reuse the existing names rather than inventing new ones:

    • object: the input phyloseq object;
    • group.by (and facet.by, color.by, …): metadata column names;
    • palette: a micropubr palette name or a vector of colours;
    • theme: a ggplot2 theme (defaults come from mp_set_defaults());
    • font.size, plot.title, plot.subtitle, plot.caption;
    • return.data = TRUE: return the tidy data frame behind the plot;
    • interactive = TRUE: return a plotly widget instead of a ggplot;
    • ...: forwarded to the primary geom. Argument names use dot.case.

  • Return a plain ggplot (or patchwork) so users can extend it with +. Base-graphics exceptions (mp_chord(), mp_circos()) return their data invisibly.

  • Errors are raised with rlang::abort() and a micropubr_* condition class so they can be caught and tested reliably:

    rlang::abort(
  sprintf("`%s` is not a column of sample_data().", group.by),
  class = "micropubr_bad_var"
)

    Use rlang::warn() / rlang::inform() for other conditions.

  • Optional packages belong in Suggests and are checked at run time with .mp_require("pkg", "What needs it", bioc = TRUE/FALSE), which raises a micropubr_missing_dependency error with an install hint.

  • Colours must stay colourblind-safe; new palettes should be added to R/mp_palette.R and listed by mp_palettes().

  • Follow the tidyverse style guide: two-space indents, <- for assignment, lines of 80 characters or fewer.

Pull requests

  1. Fork the repository and create a branch from main.
  2. Add or update tests and roxygen documentation for your change.
  3. Add a bullet to the top section of NEWS.md.
  4. Make sure devtools::check() passes locally with no new errors, warnings or notes.
  5. Open the pull request; GitHub Actions runs R CMD check on macOS, Windows and Linux, test coverage, BiocCheck and a pkgdown build.
